seo_description: International undergraduate scholarships in the USA: compare deadlines, award details, and eligibility, then apply through official program pages.
intro: Trying to find USA scholarships you can actually apply to as an international undergraduate usually means sorting through mixed eligibility rules, study levels, and requirement details. This filtered slice narrows that search to programs connected to international students, with many rows tied to undergraduate paths even when some listings may also mention other study levels. As you compare options, expect real variation across award wording, deadline timing, essay expectations, and field preferences. Some listings lean toward broad education funding, while others connect more clearly to STEM, medicine, arts, community, or related academic interests. If you want to browse efficiently for the current cycle and into upcoming USA opportunities, the rows below give you a focused place to start without assuming every program works the same way.
h1: Find Scholarships for International Undergraduates USA
supporting: Use this list to compare the parts that matter most before you apply: who the scholarship is open to, whether undergraduate applicants are clearly included, what field or category is mentioned, and how much detail the requirement line gives you. Deadlines differ by program, and some appear closer than others, so it is worth checking date text early. Award amounts also vary by listing and should be verified on the official page. Because requirement signals are mixed, read each row closely rather than assuming every scholarship is essay free or equally simple to enter.
related_intro: If you do not find enough matches here, related scholarship pages can help you compare nearby slices such as broader international student funding, category-based options like education or STEM, or listings that fit a different study level. That is often the fastest way to widen your USA search without starting over.

faq.question: How can I find USA scholarships for international undergraduate students on this page?
faq.answer: Use this filtered view to compare rows that mention international student eligibility, study level, field, and deadline text. In this USA-focused catalog, always open the official source for each listing to confirm who can apply and what documents are required.

faq.question: Can I compare award amounts and deadlines across these scholarships?
faq.answer: Yes—these rows include award and deadline information, but both vary by program. Amounts can range widely by listing, and deadlines differ by row, so check dates promptly and verify details on the official page before you apply.

faq.question: Are all of these only for undergraduate students?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. This filter is centered on international undergraduate search intent, but the catalog data in this slice can also include programs tied to other education levels, so review each row carefully before you apply.

faq.question: Do these scholarships require an essay?
faq.answer: Requirements are mixed across the listings. Some programs may ask for an essay and others may not, so compare the rows you are interested in and confirm the current application requirements with the official source.
